results.evidence_text: evaluate the associations between 92 foods or nutrients and risk of prostate cancer
results.manual_review_reason: Abstract describes a prospective nutrient-wide study of 92 foods/nutrients and incident prostate cancer, and mentions butter, but never explicitly names dairy as an evaluated exposure; neither INCLUDE nor S2-NO-TARGET-ESTIMATE can be unambiguously confirmed.
results.one_sentence_explanation: The abstract reports a prospective analysis of 92 foods or nutrients (including butter) and incident prostate cancer, which makes a dairy estimate plausible but not explicitly confirmed, so the record cannot unambiguously support either the INCLUDE claim or the S2-NO-TARGET-ESTIMATE exclusion.
